headline: Unbeaten Dortmund host a Frankfurt side that shipped six
summary: Borussia Dortmund are unbeaten in the Bundesliga and second on 14 points, and on Saturday they host Eintracht Frankfurt. The problem is freshness: Dortmund played in Bodø, Berlin and Baku in a week, 11,322 kilometres of travel, while Frankfurt have had 8 days off to Dortmund's 4. Frankfurt's own case is thin — a 0-6 defeat at RB Leipzig and 13 goals conceded in their last five league games. That is why the market makes Dortmund 65.2% favourites, rated a head start of one and a quarter goals better, with 3.5 goals expected.
read: Dortmund are unbeaten in the Bundesliga and second in the table, and the market makes them 65.2% favourites to beat a Frankfurt side that conceded six at Leipzig and has shipped 13 goals in five games. The goal line sits at 3.59, with each of the last two meetings producing five goals or more.

facts.fact: The market makes Borussia Dortmund 65.2% favourites to win.
facts.meaning: More likely than not — roughly four times Frankfurt's chance of a win.

facts.fact: Dortmund are second in the Bundesliga, unbeaten after six games on 14 points.
facts.meaning: Nobody has beaten them in the league this season, and they are the higher-placed side by nine positions.

facts.fact: Frankfurt lost 0-6 at RB Leipzig on 10 October.
facts.meaning: Their only away trip to a top side this season ended in a rout, and it is the result the market is pricing.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap is Dortmund -1.25 — they are rated about one and a quarter goals the better side.
facts.meaning: A comfortable Dortmund win is expected, not a tight one; a one-goal win would leave the handicap short.

facts.fact: Dortmund played in Baku on Tuesday, four days before this game, while Frankfurt have not played since 16 October.
facts.meaning: Frankfurt arrive with double the recovery time — freshness is their main weapon here.

facts.fact: Serhou Guirassy scored twice in Dortmund's 2-1 Champions League win at Sabah FK on Tuesday.
facts.meaning: The forward Dortmund look to is scoring going into the weekend, after a midweek brace.

facts.fact: Frankfurt have conceded 2.23 xG per game over their last five, compared with 1.11 for Dortmund.
facts.meaning: Frankfurt give up good chances almost every week; Dortmund's defence concedes far fewer.

facts.fact: The market's fair goal total is 3.59 goals.
facts.meaning: Over 3.5 is the marginal favourite at 51.8% — four goals or more is more likely than not, but only just.

sources.fact: Borussia Dortmund ended a run of three defeats across all competitions with a 2-1 Champions League win at Sabah FK, in which Serhou Guirassy scored twice.
Serhou Guirassy has two Bundesliga goals this season and Dortmund will look to him again when Eintracht Frankfurt visit on Saturday.
Dortmund travelled 11,322 kilometres in a week across Bodø, Berlin and Baku, arriving back shortly before facing Frankfurt, with players and staff calling the schedule exhausting.
Jobe Bellingham was not in Dortmund's starting XI against Sabah but was named among the substitutes.
Dortmund's last Bundesliga match ended 0-0 against 1. FC Union Berlin.
Eintracht Frankfurt confirmed that sporting director Markus Krösche left the club at his own request.
Italian media and Fabrizio Romano report that AC Milan are in advanced talks to appoint Krösche as Head of Football, with Frankfurt holding an exit clause worth between 3.5 and 5 million euros.
Frankfurt coach Adi Hütter, whose side play at Dortmund on Saturday, says he has good memories of beating Borussia Dortmund.
